portGaps.reason: Variable-step and variable-order history controllers are not ported. Fixed AB/ABM orders 2–5 are available.
Fixed-target NDF1–5 with variable-h differences and defect control are available. The separate variable-order AdaptiveNDF controller is not yet ported.
Source recurrences are expanded at three bounded stage configurations per method. Automatic spectral stage selection and larger source stage counts are not ported.
Custom constrained mechanics and application-defined projection contracts are not ported.
Browser states use fixed numeric layouts. Arbitrary Python callbacks, autograd graphs, custom lifecycle hooks, checkpoint compatibility and particle reordering are not portable.
